capabilities: Display character notes as cards grouped by archive and group
Edit card properties and covers from the gallery
Create new characters from a starter template
Publish the gallery as a hosted HTML page
extras: Optional Web share uses a maintainer-operated hosted service (links expire after 7/30 days or 1 year) or self-hosting; ordinary gallery use makes no network requests. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation includes a Korean-language guide.
problem: Obsidian shows notes only as lists and files, so browsing a large cast of character notes visually requires reading each file.

relations.evidence: You can instead use your own compatible Cloudflare host or publish to GitHub Pages.
use your own compatible Cloudflare host or publish to GitHub Pages

summary: Card-gallery view that renders character notes as grouped cards with covers, status, relations, and filter chips, with optional web publishing.
